Terms of use

last updated 2026-11-12

The short version. The full terms are at /terms, and they are what counts.

On this page
  • In short
  • Full terms
/termsBack to top

In short#

No warranty, no SLA

Free, as is, no uptime promise. Data can be wrong or out of date, and the service may change or stop at any time.

Attribution

Keep the sources and credits that come with the data, community fits and wiki text included.

Acceptable use

Respect the limits, don't mirror ESI or scrape the fit corpus, no botting, client modification or real-money trading.

Fenris Creations and the DLA

The game data belongs to Fenris Creations. What you build must stay within the EVE Developer License Agreement.

Your own keys (Janice)

Optional. Forwarded to Janice for that one request only; never stored or logged. The project's key is never used for you.

Privacy

No cookies, no analytics. An account only if you create an API key. Your IP is held in memory for the limits only, including the daily trial count; access logs carry no IP, key or body and are kept 30 days.

Contact

Questions, feedback and support: the EVE-Cyno Discord.
